pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular, multi-sided polygonal geometries. Edge transitions are characterized by smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions, likely due to image resolution or motion blur. Spatial area of patches is significantly greater than the surrounding light network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light negative space forms a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively narrow and consistent, creating a highly interconnected grid across the flank and neck base.
